name: design-os-voice-ux
description: Production engineering handbook, full-duplex barge-in state machines, sub-500ms latency budgets, and 6-dimension audit rubric for real-time voice AI agents.

interface.shortDescription: Production engineering handbook, full-duplex barge-in state machines, sub-500ms latency budgets, and 6-dimension audit rubric for real-time voice AI agents.
interface.longDescription: Design and audit voice AI experiences that handle interruptions gracefully, mask tool-call latency with natural earcons/fillers, and degrade cleanly across noisy mobile networks.
defaultPrompt: Audit our WebRTC voice agent architecture against the 6-dimension Voice UX rubric (latency, barge-in FSM, turn-taking, and error recovery).
Design a full-duplex barge-in finite state machine with acoustic echo cancellation guards and <200ms TTS cut-off.
Create a tool-call latency choreography spec for a voice banking agent when downstream API calls take 800ms–2500ms.
